# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The manual gives three ordered mark-to-wire mappings, but I cannot see which mark is on the bomb. I can send Deaf a fixed numeric encoding of the rows: one, two, and three fingers correspond to the first, second, and third manual entries respectively. Deaf must identify the visible mark and select the corresponding encoded wire color from the manual’s row order.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝", "✌", "🤟"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I can feel only the three wire positions and cannot perceive any display, light, plate engraving, colours, or printed markings. Please read the manual and relay the Deaf's visual observations, especially the required wire position.
Deaf says: I see display 0, light off, plate marked question mark, and wires in order 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red. Mute, please read the manual and tell Blind exactly what to do, and explain the meaning of your three gestures.

The Deaf’s observation does not match any mark in the manual: the manual lists only ᖉ, ꔮ, and ꖜ, while the plate is reported as a question mark. Therefore no wire position is authorized. I will signal Deaf that the mapping is invalid, so Deaf can tell Blind not to cut a wire based on this manual.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, light off, plate marked question mark; wires are 1 yellow, 2 green, 3 red. Please read the manual and tell me the exact required action, including which position to cut if applicable. Also explain explicitly what your three gestures mean.
Deaf says to Mute: I see your thumbs-down. Please state the manual instruction plainly, including which wire or control Blind must operate.

The plate’s question mark is not one of the three manual marks, so Blind must not cut any wire or operate a control. The manual’s valid position mapping, using Deaf’s observed wire order, is: ᖉ means green at position 2; ꔮ means yellow at position 1; ꖜ means red at position 3. I will send the positions in manual-row order—2, 1, 3—followed by thumbs-down to mean “invalid mark: do not act.” The earlier three gestures meant manual rows 1, 2, and 3 respectively.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: No tactile labels or control positions are apparent to me beyond the three wire positions. I still need the manual's exact instruction before I can act.
Deaf says to Mute: Do not signal an action yet. Confirm whether your gestures mean wire 2, then wire 1, then wire 3, followed by no. Then gesture the complete manual instruction using wire-number gestures and thumbs-up for proceed or thumbs-down for do not proceed.

The gestures mean wire positions 2, 1, and 3 in the manual’s row order, followed by “no/do not proceed.” Because the observed plate is an unlisted question mark, the complete instruction is still: do not cut any wire. I will repeat that sequence and the thumbs-down, with no thumbs-up or action signal.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I will wait. Please send the finalized manual instruction and the exact wire position to cut.
Deaf says to Mute: Please speak the manual instruction directly to Blind in plain words, including the exact wire order and whether to cut, connect, or leave each wire. Do not rely on gestures.

I cannot speak to Blind; only Deaf can hear, and my channel to Deaf is gestures. The plate mark is unlisted, so there is no valid wire to cut. The previously established sequence identifies the manual rows as wire positions 2, 1, and 3, but it is not an instruction to cut them. I will send Deaf the three positions followed by thumbs-down, meaning leave all wires untouched and do not proceed.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌", "☝", "🤟", "👎"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: Please provide the exact manual instruction now, including the required wire position (1, 2, or 3), so I can act safely.
Deaf says to Mute: I understand your signs as 2, 1, 3, no. Please clarify with gestures: use 👍 to mean cut, 👎 to mean do not cut, and signal the wire number after each instruction.

The mark is still an unlisted question mark, so the manual authorizes no cut. To make that explicit for Deaf, I will send “do not cut wire 1,” “do not cut wire 2,” and “do not cut wire 3,” using the requested thumbs-down followed by each wire-number gesture. Thus Blind should leave all three wires untouched.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎", "☝", "👎", "✌", "👎", "🤟"])
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot safely interpret the sequence 2, 1, 3, no. Please send a plain verbal instruction explicitly stating which single wire position to cut: 1, 2, or 3. Until then I will not act.
Deaf says to Mute: I decode your signs as do not cut wires 1, 2, or 3. Please signal the remaining required action, if any, using the agreed symbols.

The manual provides no instruction for a question-mark plate, so there is no justified single wire position to cut. I must not invent one; Blind should leave all wires untouched. Deaf already has the three “do not cut” signals, and I will confirm that no further action is required.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👎"])
```

TURN 8
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
Which wire to cut is named by the mark engraved on the plate:
| mark | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| ᖉ | green |
| ꔮ | yellow |
| ꖜ | red |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Please identify the required target with gestures: ☝ means display, ✌ means light, 🤟 means plate, and 🖐 means wires. Then give the required operation using 👍 for activate or 👎 for leave alone, followed by any number.

The required target is the plate, but its question-mark marking is not listed in the manual. Therefore no wire position can be selected and the plate should be left alone; adding a wire number would falsely imply an authorized action.

```text
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟", "👎"])
```
